lead.headline: BJP PROTESTS SPREAD ACROSS INDIA AFTER KHARGE REMARK
lead.deck: Demonstrations in Bengaluru and other cities demand an apology from the Congress president

image.caption: India’s political debate moved from Patna to streets across the country on Monday. (Representative image / Wikimedia Commons)

paragraphs: The Bharatiya Janata Party staged protests in several states on Monday after Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge made a controversial remark about Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s late father at an event in Patna. Demonstrators demanded an apology.

Reports from Bengaluru, Bihar, Jammu, Delhi and Lucknow described demonstrations by BJP workers. The row followed an exchange with an audience member during a birth-anniversary event for Bihar’s first chief minister, Shrikrishna Singh.

The dispute has become a national political flashpoint, with BJP leaders calling the remark offensive and Congress figures contesting the party’s response. The demonstrations unfolded a day after Kharge’s comment.

sidebarStory.subhead: Traffic police data points to a sharp rise in crashes across the city
paragraphs: Local coverage citing Bengaluru Traffic Police data says road accidents rose by around 70% over five years, bringing renewed focus to road safety.

stories.subhead: Traffic police figures show a steep five-year increase
paragraphs: Bengaluru road accidents rose by around 70% over five years, according to city coverage citing Bengaluru Traffic Police data.

stories.subhead: Newly inaugurated Bengaluru road reported damaged after four months
paragraphs: Fresh potholes and depressions have appeared on SM Krishna Road only months after its inauguration, according to local reporting.

stories.headline: BJP PROTESTS ACROSS STATES OVER KHARGE REMARK
stories.deck: Party workers demand an apology after Congress chief’s comment about PM Modi’s late father

image.caption: Political demonstrations were reported in cities across India. (Representative image / Wikimedia Commons)

paragraphs: The BJP held demonstrations in Bengaluru, Bihar, Jammu and other cities on Monday over Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge’s remark at an event in Patna. The party demanded an apology.

Congress leaders disputed the BJP’s response as the remarks triggered a broader political row. The protests followed a comment made during an audience exchange at the birth anniversary event for Shrikrishna Singh.

stories.headline: JUDGE’S MINOR SON TAKEN INTO CUSTODY AFTER FATAL CRASH
paragraphs: Police in Kochi took a judge’s minor son into custody after a Mercedes allegedly driven by the teenager hit and killed a scooter rider. The victim’s family called for accountability.

stories.headline: EC TELLS SUPREME COURT SIR ORDERS WERE UNANIMOUS
paragraphs: The Election Commission told the Supreme Court that all three members unanimously approved the orders implementing the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls, PTI reported.
